method.method_draft: Treat the picture as a graph with 8 corner vertices. First read the fixed labels from the image: top vertex is 1, right-middle vertex is 2, bottom vertex is 3. Also read the shown edges: the four corner vertices at upper-left, upper-right, lower-right, and lower-left are each joined by lines to all three of these labelled vertices 1, 2, and 3. From the text, adjacent endpoints of every shown line must have different numbers and only 1, 2, 3, 4 may be used. Therefore each of those four vertices cannot be 1, 2, or 3, so each must be 4. Finally check the remaining left-middle vertex: it is joined to the surrounding four vertices just identified as 4, so it cannot also be 4. Hence the number 4 appears exactly 4 times.
